themes.note: Frontmatter colors are the dark values. colorMeta.<token>.light holds the light value; the system theme follows prefers-color-scheme. Tokens live as CSS custom properties in src/app/globals.css (cssVar).

display.purpose: The verdict, in its standing colour. Literata, tabular lining numerals.

headline.purpose: Page h1, e.g. company name in the application header.

label.purpose: Terms, hints, buttons, badges; sentence case, never uppercase-tracked.

shadows.name: sheet-dark
shadows.purpose: --shadow-sheet in dark: every sheet, the phase strip, a selected segment.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: --ease-out-soft: the easing for settle, ink and folder tabs.

motion.name: settle
motion.value: settle 420ms ease-out-soft backwards; from opacity 0, translateY(6px), blur(2px)
motion.purpose: .anim-settle: sheets and rows appearing; stagger via --delay at 45ms per item, capped at 8.

motion.name: ink
motion.value: ink-in 600ms ease-out-soft backwards; scaleX from 0, origin left

motion.name: folder-tab
motion.purpose: Tab rising to join its sheet.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce -> animation: none; transition: none
motion.purpose: Every animation and transition collapses to an instant change.

viz.rule: Chart fills use the theme-aware variables, never hex. Single-hue cinnabar ordinal ramp per theme, validated with the dataviz palette validator (--ordinal) against each theme's sheet.

narrative.overview:
Onward is a file the candidate keeps on each role: paper sheets on a desk, read and annotated, not a dashboard of tiles. Warm walnut ink at night (the daily theme), warm stone paper by day. Sheets are raised with small paper corners and one soft shadow; Literata sets headings and the numbers that matter, the system sans carries all working text.

Colour carries meaning. Cinnabar, a warm orange-red, marks actions and where you are; moss is backed, straw is related or to confirm, crimson is a gap. Nothing else is coloured, so a coloured word is always a judgement.

Motion is quiet and comes once: sheets settle, a ledger bar inks in, folder tabs rise to join their sheet; all of it collapses under reduced motion.
keyCharacteristics: One action colour (cinnabar) plus three standing tones, each solid and wash
Literata for h1, h2 and display numerals; system sans for working text
Small paper corners (5/7/9px) and one sheet shadow
Folder tabs: the selected tab and its sheet are one piece

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Moss, straw and crimson appear only for standing, never decoration; always paired with a word or icon.

rules.name: The On-Solid Rule
rules.body: Text on any solid fill uses --color-on-solid, never white and never the ground colour.

rules.name: The Hue Distance Rule
rules.body: Cinnabar (hue about 45-50) stays clearly apart from crimson (about 16) and straw (about 90); never a plain red or yellow accent, which would read as a status.

rules.name: The Chart Variable Rule
rules.body: Chart fills use --color-viz-1 and --color-viz-ord-1..5, theme-aware, never hex.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: The serif is for h1, h2 and display numerals only; working text stays in the sans; aligned numerals are tabular.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: A surface is on the ground or a sheet; no intermediate elevations, no hard offset shadows.

dos: Do set short word lists as a running index line parted by faint dots.
Do put text on any solid fill in on-solid.
Do pair every standing colour with a word or icon.
Do use the sheet as the only raised container.
Do reserve the serif for h1, h2 and display numerals.
Do stagger entrances 45ms, capped, and ink a fill once.
donts: Don't box each keyword as a chip or pill.
Don't summarise with a row of stat tiles.
Don't put uppercase tracked eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use gradient fills on avatars or anywhere else.
Don't use a coloured left border thicker than 1px.
Don't use white text, or the ground colour, on a solid fill.
Don't add decorative colours beyond cinnabar and the three standing tones.
Don't pick a plain red or yellow accent, or move cinnabar toward crimson or straw.
Don't fill charts with hex values; use the viz variables.
